items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: I was playing there with a fellow by the name of Tink. Piano player.

ctx.x: No, go ahead. Well, let me think. I wanted to ask you about when you got into the La Vida dance hall. How did you come by that job? Or was it too much of a jump from where we were? No. Uh...
I was playing there with a fellow by the name of Tink. Piano player. Tink's been there, oh, in quite a number of years. Tink was that Tink? Yeah, but, uh... Yeah.
